name: minerva
description: R0 groundwork for the greenfield Minerva prototype.

scripts.secrets:scan: ignored_tracked=$(git ls-files --cached --ignored --exclude-standard); test -z "$ignored_tracked" || { printf '%s\n' "$ignored_tracked" >&2; exit 1; }; gitleaks git --redact --no-banner --no-color
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run secrets:scan && npm run roadmap:status
